thread:
iona-docs: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR for a Disconnected Site / Init Network playbook. Goal: single page that consolidates preflight, offline package mirror, KMS/HSM offline keywrap, and conn-checker examples. Wanted to sync on what to include.

samir-eng: Thanks — can you add an mtls proxy chaining example and a short note about which model-serving ports we actually need open? not the whole list.

claire-sre: Preflight checklist please include explicit ports + NAT behavior and a tiny test plan: verify DNS, time (ntp/chrony), and HSM PIN accessibility. Also call out that HSM provisioning often fails if /dev/random blocking on tiny VMs. :warning:

iona-docs: Good call. Draft plan: 1) preflight checklist 2) package mirror (apt/yum + offline tarball) 3) network matrix (inbound for admin, outbound for KMS wrap only) 4) KMS/HSM snippets 5) conn-checker examples + troubleshooting notes.

ben-platform: For package mirror add this snippet for apt proxying and checksum verification:```
# mirror example (debian)
mkdir -p /opt/offline-mirror && rsync -av --delete rsync://mirror.example.com/debian /opt/offline-mirror
sha256sum /opt/offline-mirror/**/*.deb > /opt/offline-mirror/SHA256SUMS
```

samir-eng: For MTLS proxy chain, include this minimal envoy config snippet and a note that we recommend simple 1:1 proxy for sealed networks. Also include the CLI example to run conn-checker in airgapped env:```
# run conn-checker in airgapped mode
./conn-checker --mode=offline --kubeconfig=/etc/redwood/kubeconfig --host=10.0.0.5
```

claire-sre: HSM note: include PKCS#11 env var example and a fallback to software keywrap in docs. Something like:```
export PKCS11_PROVIDER=/usr/lib/libpkcs11.so
redwoodctl kms wrap --key-id=slot1 --input=keyfile.der --out=keyfile.wrapped
```

iona-docs: I'll add both the PKCS11 snippet and a short paragraph explaining failure modes (permissions, missing slot, library ABI mismatch). Also will add a link to the HSM firmware checklist. Need the canonical doc link — there's an old internal one that is broken.

ben-platform: Old link is internal/ops/hsm-init which is deprecated. Use private/connectivity/hsm-quickstart instead. Update redirect or change link in the PR.

iona-docs: Will update. Also planning two tiny SDK snippets for offline keywrap usage: Node and Python. Draft Node snippet:```
// node example: wrap local key and upload
const {KMSClient, WrapKeyCommand} = require('@redwood/kms');
const c = new KMSClient({mode: 'offline'});
await c.send(new WrapKeyCommand({keyId: 'hsm-slot-1', buffer: Buffer.from('...')}));
```

iona-docs: Draft Python snippet:```
# python example
from redwood_kms import KMSClient
c = KMSClient(mode='offline')
res = c.wrap_key(key_id='slot1', data=b'...')
```

samir-eng: Keep snippets intentionally tiny. Add comment to warn that in airgapped installs the SDK must point at the local proxy and that retries should be exponential backoff.

claire-sre: Also add a short troubleshooting table: symptom -> quick check -> fix. Example rows: HSM not seen -> check udev rules & pkcs11 path; conn-checker timeout -> check NAT and egress rule to KMS IP.

iona-docs: Will add table and a one-line migration note for customers moving from hybrid to fully disconnected: run offline export of keys, verify wrapped blobs with the HSM before decommission. Include the commands.

pr-bot: PR opened by iona-docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — "disconnected-site-init-playbook". CI: docs-lint passed, linkcheck failed for one old internal URL.

iona-docs: ^ thanks — linkcheck failure is the old hsm link. I'll swap it to private/connectivity/hsm-quickstart.

ben-platform: Small ask: add a note under 'rollbacks' about key unwrap when restoring to a new HSM model — we saw vendor ABI differences. One-liner warning is fine.

samir-eng: :eyes: I'll review the MTLS and envoy examples tomorrow. If anyone has short test clusters for an airgapped flow, ping me.

claire-sre: Quick checklist addition: run `journalctl -u redwood-service --since \"5m\"` after install and capture errors in the PR if any.

iona-docs: Thanks all — I'll update the PR now: move hsm link, add PKCS11 snippet, package mirror example, conn-checker offline CLI, node/python SDK samples, and a troubleshooting appendix. Tagging reviewers @samir-eng @claire-sre @ben-platform. :shipit:
